_note: Power consumed inside the habitat, in kWh per day, split by category. The categories are yours to shape: rename a label, add one, remove one — the key is the stable name in the record, the label is what the station shows. Days are filed as "1": { "heating": 1.1, "food": 0.5, ... } — on the Habitat tab of mission control or here; a save is live within a couple of seconds. Emptied of its days by the reset; the categories stay. A category may name a Home Assistant energy meter as "sensor" (the entity id without "sensor."): its day then reads that meter — the day's last reading less the day before's last, since the meter only grows — unless a figure is filed by hand for that day, which wins.
